title: Díaz-Canel Tells Mexico Forum the Blockade Threatens Any Sovereign State
detail: In a video message to a Labor Party of Mexico seminar, Díaz-Canel called US policy hostile, denounced Trump's January 29 and May 1 executive orders, and said fuel ships have been kept out of Cuban ports for nine months. He cited 21.4% renewable electricity and 1,418 MW of solar. CiberCuba reports at least eight national grid collapses in 2026.

media.caption: Díaz-Canel addresses Mexican left forum on blockade
